supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: significant lateral extension beyond the outer ocular margins

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: high contrast with a significantly lighter muzzle and chin area compared to the dark periocular and cranial regions

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: moderate vertical thickness with a neutral, slightly protruding lower lip

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: visible depigmented spotting and potential scarring on the lower lip and chin
